# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| Latest release | Yes |
| `main` | Yes |
| Older releases | No |

## Reporting

Report vulnerabilities through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/yowainwright/struct-lint/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue.

Include affected versions, platform details, impact, reproduction steps, and
any proposed mitigation. Expect acknowledgment within 48 hours and an initial
assessment within five business days.
